text:
The quotation is about requesting a competition authority (CMA) to review the market structure of the English early years childcare sector. The specific mechanism is a market investigation into competitive conditions in the childcare industry.

Primary dimension: This is fundamentally about industrial organization — market structure review of the childcare market by a competition authority. L4 (Antitrust Issues and Policies) or L8 (Industry Studies: Services) fit well, with L being the best major category.

Secondary dimension: The childcare sector also falls under I2 (Education and Research Institutions) as early years childcare is an education/care service.

{"primary": "L", "secondary": ["I"]}
